facts.heading: Divorce after 15 years
facts.content: Jana and her husband decided to get a divorce after 15 years of marriage. Jana still cannot understand the decision.
facts.evidence: After 15 years of marriage, my husband and I decided to get a divorce. And I still can't understand it.

facts.heading: Husband not allowed in Croatia
facts.content: Vladez Znobirin is not allowed in Croatia. He told Jana that things were not going any further in September.
facts.evidence: Vladez Znobirin is not allowed in Croatia. And in September he told me that it was not going any further.

facts.heading: Jana's internal feelings
facts.content: Jana experienced emptiness and anger several times a day. These feelings occurred after the divorce.
facts.evidence: Emptiness. Then anger. Then emptiness again. It was several times a day.

facts.heading: Regret about blindness
facts.content: Jana thinks she should have seen things and feels she was blind. She keeps looking for mistakes.
facts.evidence: That I should have seen it, that I was blind. I keep thinking about it and I keep looking for mistakes.

facts.heading: Reason for feeling tired
facts.content: Jana thinks she was too tired and not interested in the issues. She attributes this to getting too old.
facts.evidence: I think I was too tired and I wasn't interested in them. Only that I got too old.

facts.heading: Difficulty telling children
facts.content: Jana has two children, Anšce and Matěj, who are 8 years old. She does not know how to tell them about the divorce.
facts.evidence: I have two kids, Anšce and Matěj. They are 8 years old. I don't know how to tell them.

facts.heading: Anšce's suspicion
facts.content: Anšce is becoming more suspicious about the situation. She asked Jana if they were dating last week.
facts.evidence: Anička is already getting a bit more suspicious. Last week she asked me if we were dating.

facts.heading: Anšce's lie
facts.content: Anšce lied to Jana and knew it. She lied about Jana destroying her life and taking her home.
facts.evidence: She lied to me. And she knew it. I saw it in her eyes. That I destroy her life. That I take her home.

facts.heading: Jana's fear of tears
facts.content: Jana is afraid of her children's tears when telling them the truth. She prefers to keep the truth with her.
facts.evidence: I'd rather have it with me, but I'm afraid of their tears.

facts.heading: Matěj's understanding
facts.content: Matěj is still small and does not understand much about the situation. Jana feels they both like him and it doesn't change.
facts.evidence: And Matěj is still small, he doesn't understand much. That we both like him and that it doesn't change.

facts.heading: Living situation concerns
facts.content: Jana is uncertain about how things will look with the residents. She prefers to feel like a real person living in a mortgage.
facts.evidence: How will it look with the residents? Living in a mortgage, I'd rather feel like a real person, at least with that.

facts.heading: Editor handled money
facts.content: The editor solved the money issues. Jana cannot do it herself.
facts.evidence: The editor always solved the money. I can't do it myself.

facts.heading: Jana's occupation
facts.content: Jana works as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno. She teaches 9th and 8th grade.
facts.evidence: I work as a Czech teacher at a primary school in Brno. I teach 9th and 8th grade.

facts.heading: Current study habit
facts.content: Jana studies by walking around with a rabbit in her hand.
facts.evidence: I walk around with a rabbit in my hand.

facts.heading: Feeling life is falling apart
facts.content: Jana feels like everyone sees her life is falling apart. She told the principal about it because she once cried on the court.
facts.evidence: I feel like everyone sees that my life is falling apart. I told her that because I once cried on the court.

facts.heading: Principal gave Jana time off
facts.content: The principal let Jana leave earlier and gave her an hour off. This helped Jana.
facts.evidence: She let me leave earlier. She gave me an hour off.

facts.heading: Jana is alone at work
facts.content: Jana felt worse when she was alone at work because she had something to do.
facts.evidence: Because I was alone at work. I had at least something to do.

facts.heading: Jana wakes up at 3am
facts.content: Jana wakes up at 3am every night and thinks about what is next.
facts.evidence: Every night I wake up at 3am and I think about what's next.

facts.heading: Jana's thoughts upon waking
facts.content: When Jana wakes up, she thinks about not having a mortgage, a wife, or anything. She counts money and imagines telling her kids.
facts.evidence: I don't have a mortgage, I don't have a wife, I don't have anything. I count the money, I imagine how I tell my kids.

facts.heading: Jana's sleep schedule
facts.content: Jana sleeps around 5 and wakes up at half past 7. She feels tired in the morning.
facts.evidence: I sleep around 5 and wake up at half past 7. I'm tired in the morning.

facts.heading: Jana has lost weight
facts.content: Jana does not move much and has lost 4 kilos. A friend tells her she looks terrible.
facts.evidence: I don't move much. I lost 4 kilos. My friend tells me I look terrible.

facts.heading: Sister calls Jana nightly
facts.content: Jana has a sister in Olomouc who calls her almost every evening.
facts.evidence: I have a sister in Olomouc. She calls me almost every evening.

facts.heading: Friend Eva's comment
facts.content: A friend of Eva's from work says almost everything to Jana. Eva only says Jana is having a hard time and does not want Jana to think about anything.
facts.evidence: Eva only says that I'm having a hard time. She doesn't want me to think about anything.

facts.heading: Sister's comment on marriage
facts.content: The sister said that a woman who cannot hold a marriage is not a good example for children. This thought probably comes from Jana's mom.
facts.evidence: That a woman who can't hold a marriage isn't a good example for children. Probably from my mom. She always said that marriage is held and it's up to you.

facts.heading: Sister's reaction to Jana
facts.content: When Jana told her, the sister was sad and hoped Jana had been good to her. The sister has not called Jana much since then.
facts.evidence: She was sad. Then she said that she hopes I've been good to her. She hasn't called me much since then.

facts.heading: Jana's feelings about telling
facts.content: Jana feels sad when she speaks her feelings out loud. She is crying when she says it out loud.
facts.evidence: I'm crying. I'm sorry.

facts.heading: Jana's hesitation to share
facts.content: Jana has not told anyone about this yet. She feels it is her fault that she said it out loud.
facts.evidence: Thank you. I haven't told anyone about this yet. It's your fault that you said it out loud.

facts.heading: Jana's desire for sleep help
facts.content: Jana asked what could help her most, and she named sleep. She asked about sleeping and what she has tried.
facts.evidence: What could he do to help you most? Sleep. And you, grandpa, how do you sleep? What about sleeping? Have you tried anything?

facts.heading: Jana avoids medication
facts.content: Jana drinks tea but does not want pills. She is afraid she would not wake up in time for the kids and does not want to be addicted.
facts.evidence: I drink tea, that's all. The doctor doesn't give me pills, but I don't want to. I'm afraid I wouldn't wake up in time for the kids and I don't want to be addicted.

facts.heading: Fear of panic and crying
facts.content: Jana is afraid of panicking and crying. She is afraid of not staying calm.
facts.evidence: That I panic and cry. That I can't stay calm.

facts.heading: Fear of being a coward
facts.content: Jana is afraid of being a coward. She finds this fear scary.
facts.evidence: That I would be a coward? That would be scary for me.

facts.heading: Desire to be seen
facts.content: Jana hopes others will see that they are allowed to do things.
facts.evidence: Or maybe they could see that we're allowed to do so.

facts.heading: Goal for today
facts.content: Jana plans to focus on feeling not being alone. She also plans to focus on not having to do things right away.
facts.evidence: That I'm not alone and that I don't have to do it right away.
